summary.id: Memetakan tujuan bisnis, batasan pengguna nyata, profil jaringan, dan risiko teknis sebelum menyentuh desain maupun kode.
summary.en: Mapping business objectives, real-world user constraints, connectivity profiles, and technical risks before visual or code execution.

clientInput.id: Akses narasumber domain, contoh data/perangkat eksisting, serta prioritas fitur utama.
clientInput.en: Domain stakeholder interview, sample payloads or hardware specs, and core feature priority.

summary.id: Menetapkan topologi sistem, skema database/API, dan wireframe atau design system agar tidak ada rework di tengah pengembangan.
summary.en: Locking system topology, database/API contracts, wireframes, and UI tokens so engineering progresses without costly rework.

clientInput.id: Validasi alur kerja pengguna dan persetujuan rancangan antarmuka sebelum fase build.
clientInput.en: Sign-off on user workflows and core screen layouts prior to engineering sprint.

summary.id: Implementasi bertahap dalam modul terukur dengan staging preview berkala, pemeriksaan tipe statis, dan pengujian integrasi.
summary.en: Incremental modular implementation with regular staging previews, strict static checks, and end-to-end integration validation.

id: Staging Build untuk Uji Coba Berkala

clientInput.id: Umpan balik terfokus per milestone staging (maksimal 2x24 jam agar ritme terjaga).
clientInput.en: Focused feedback per staging drop within 48 hours to keep delivery cadence tight.

summary.id: Audit performa, aksesibilitas, keamanan konfigurasi, serta deployment ke server atau distribusi Android dengan checklist rilis ketat.
summary.en: Performance profiling, accessibility verification, environment hardening, and controlled production deployment or APK/AAB release.

clientInput.id: Kredensial hosting/domain/Play Console dan pengujian UAT akhir.
clientInput.en: Production server/domain/Play Console access and final User Acceptance Testing.

summary.id: Serah terima penuh aset desain dan kode sumber agar klien independen, disertai jendela stabilisasi pasca-rilis.
summary.en: Clean ownership handover of source code and design files so client teams stay independent, backed by a post-launch stabilization window.

clientInput.id: Konfirmasi penerima akun repositori dan penjadwalan sesi pelatihan admin.
clientInput.en: Confirmation of repository owner accounts and scheduling for admin handover session.
